_non_indonesia_cars: everything below is OPTIONAL — defaults are the Jaecoo J5 / Indonesia values

specs._comment: OPTIONAL brochure figures for YOUR model. Omit and the spec card is hidden rather than showing another car's numbers.
specs.label: Your Car

resync_km_comment: late cloud re-sync bursts (odo catches up after the car was dark): skip = accurate per-day totals (default, recommended) | count = add them to the day the car reconnected

mqtt._comment: OPTIONAL Home Assistant MQTT bridge (also configurable in Settings). Needs paho-mqtt from requirements.txt. Opcode map: tools/control_opcodes.json. Topics are {base_topic}/{VIN}/… so two cars can share the same base_topic.
